pose_nms_symmetry — 3D match_pose op

• 데이터 종류: table × points × table → table

• 호출: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.pose_nms_symmetry(hypotheses, model_points, symmetries=(), distance_threshold: 'float' = 1.0, top_n: 'int | None' = None) -> 'list[PoseHypothesis]'(구현을 직접 호출하려면 import ppf; ppf.pose_nms_symmetry(hypotheses, model_points, symmetries=(), distance_threshold: 'float' = 1.0, top_n: 'int | None' = None) -> 'list[PoseHypothesis]', 원장에서 가져오려면 ops3d.get("pose_nms_symmetry"))

• GPU: 없음(CPU 참조 구현만)

사용법

모델 공간 거리 안에서 대칭적으로 동등한 자세만 억제합니다.

> 아래 상세 설명은 원문입니다 —— 요약과 제목은 번역되어 있습니다.

Candidates are processed by descending score (then votes). A candidate is removed only if the maximum transformed-model-point distance to a kept pose, minimized over the supplied BOP 4x4 symmetries, is at most distance_threshold. Consequently a symmetry-equivalent orientation is merged, while a non-equivalent orientation or another object instance whose translation is farther away remains. Identity is inserted automatically.

This is an exact point-set test over the supplied points, not a bounding-box proxy. The threshold uses the same unit as model_points and t. Empty, non-finite or malformed inputs fail closed.

score と票の順に候補を見て、BOP 4x4 対称変換のどれかを介したモデル点の最大距離が閾値以下の時だけ抑制する。したがって対称で同じ向きはまとまり、非対称な向きと、並進の離れた別個体は残る。箱・球の代用ではなく指定モデル点を直接測る。

Examples

>>> points = np.array([[1., 0., 0.], [-1., 0., 0.], [0., .3, .2]])

>>> a = PoseHypothesis(np.eye(3), np.zeros(3), 9, .9, .9, .1)

>>> b = PoseHypothesis(np.eye(3), np.array([5., 0., 0.]), 8, .8, .8, .2)

>>> len(pose_nms_symmetry([a, b], points, distance_threshold=.5))

2
